title: Retiring two old Claude accounts without losing desktop sessions
description: A user signed in to the Claude desktop app with a new account and wanted to keep using sessions from two retired accounts. Account names and session titles are redacted; counts come from the verified run on 2026-10-04.

items: Old account A: 123 Code sessions (122 with transcripts, 50 archived)
Old account B: 108 Code sessions from April with no transcripts left, and 77 Cowork sessions from January to June with transcripts inside their folders
Claude Code cleanupPeriodDays already set to 3650; Cowork sessions without their own setting

prompt: 我希望就基于我的新账号，之前账号不用了，但数据与 session 要用

items: Account A: 123 Code entries copied into the current account; the app listed them without a restart
Account B: 108 Code entries copied and identified as title-only orphans (102 lost transcripts to earlier 30-day cleanup, 6 never had one); the tool now skips such orphans by default
Account B: 77 Cowork sessions copied with folders; 13 still write outputs to the source folder, which was kept
cleanupPeriodDays 3650 written into all 77 migrated Cowork sessions; a follow-up plan reported 0 pending
Archived state preserved: the app rebuilt its archive index from 139 isArchived flags
